name: kg_create_edge
description: Create one relationship (edge) between two EXISTING nodes. Audited: requires a non-empty `reason`, refuses missing endpoints, self-loops, and exact-duplicate edges (same source, target, relationship_type — use kg_delete_edge first if you mean to replace), and writes the new edge to kg_revision_log so it can be reverted. Common relationship types: attended, located_at, works_for, has_child, part_of, occurred_at. Pass `dry_run: true` to preview without committing. Both nodes must already exist — use kg_create_node first if needed.

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Why this edge is correct. Goes into kg_revision_log.

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.description: Preview the edge; do not commit. Default false.

outputs.description: {ok, revision_log_id, new_edge_id} on commit; {ok, dry_run, before, after} on dry_run.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for kg_create_edge:
- source_id (required): UUID of the source node
- target_id (required): UUID of the target node
- relationship_type (required): predicate, e.g. 'works_for'
- reason (required): why this edge is correct
- sentence (optional): natural-language statement
- dry_run (optional): preview only
- finding_id (optional): source finding row id

Example:
{
    "source_id": "person-uuid",
    "target_id": "company-uuid",
    "relationship_type": "works_for",
    "reason": "User stated employment in chat on 2026-06-01",
    "sentence": "Alex works for Acme"
}
